page.title: Archive assistant
page.lead: Answers questions about the archive and helps search open materials. It runs on a local model: visitors' questions are not sent to external services.

can.find: Finds fonds, inventories, files and documents by description, not only by exact title.
can.explain: Explains how the catalogue is organised and what reference codes and access statuses mean.
can.contacts: Gives addresses, phone numbers and directions to the archive and its branches.
can.services: Explains how to get an archival certificate and links to the official service.

page.checksText: Three situations that show the assistant does not make answers up. Click a question to send it to the chat.

page.limits: It does not accept applications or requests, does not issue certificates, does not show closed documents and does not invent reference codes or links: sources for an answer are selected by the server.
